reviewScope.sourcePageMap: Printed page equals PDF ordinal for these pages.
reviewScope.table: DMG Appendix O, p.225, 64 separately inventoried value rows.

method.sourceIdentity: SHA-256 verified original PDF; each saved root PNG for PDF pages 225, 227–230 was pixel-compared against a fresh PyMuPDF render from that exact PDF using 3x matrix (216 dpi). Every RGB pixel matched.
method.visualInspection: One full source image per result for each of the five pages; p.225 source-table crop and marker crop were also inspected privately for exact row/footnote reading. No OCR output was used as proof.
method.ownerHashValidation: For every root-listed owner in the 64 rows and 95 definitions, sourceRecordHash was compared directly; renderedTextSha256 was recomputed from captured DOM innerText; searchDocumentSha256 was recomputed from canonical sorted-key JSON of the captured publicSearch object. All 115 owner references matched current snapshot; all referenced owner routes exist.
method.meaningMethod: Semantic comparison distinguishes a definition/equivalent rule from lexical mentions, title chips and incidental word occurrence. A specific rule/example may provide partial or present meaning only where its captured content establishes the relevant concept.
method.searchLimit: No arbitrary runtime query was replayed; this review uses the frozen route, DOM, and public-search document capture.
